language.label: Language
language.hint: Display language for on-screen text such as menus and buttons.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.customColorsHint: Set the 12 core colors and the rest (surface steps, muted, soft backgrounds, focus ring, etc.) are derived automatically.

brand.title: Brand
brand.wordmarkHint: Sidebar logo. Split into two parts shown in different colors. (Collapsed sidebar shows each first letter.)
brand.windowTitleHint: Used as the browser tab and desktop app window title. (Applied on save.)
brand.appIconHint: Used as the running taskbar/window icon. Small PNG/ICO recommended (SVG unsupported). The exe's own icon and the pinned taskbar icon don't change.
brand.iconTooBig: Icon is large (>256KB). A small PNG/ICO is recommended.

markdown.title: Markdown viewer
markdown.fontSizeHint: Applied instantly to markdown rendering (meetings, work log, WBS details, etc.).
markdown.sample:
# Meeting sample

This paragraph previews the **current font size** and *line height*. Use the sliders to tune body readability for your screen distance and resolution.

- First item — a decision or note.
- Second item — includes `inline code` too.

behavior.title: Defaults
behavior.defaultAuthorPlaceholder: Name pre-filled in change log, meetings, etc.
behavior.defaultTaskViewHint: The view shown by default when opening the Tasks tab.
behavior.shortcutsHelpHint: Can also be opened with the ? key on any page.
behavior.aiWarnBold: Using this may incur additional charges.
behavior.aiWarnText: Summaries consume your Claude subscription / API usage.
behavior.aiCliDesc: Calls the locally installed claude CLI via claude -p (print mode, prompt passed on stdin) to generate summaries. The CLI must be installed and logged in.
behavior.aiButtonHint: Shows a button on the meeting form that summarizes the discussion with claude.
behavior.connTestHint: Calls the claude CLI once to check install, auth, and response.
behavior.claudeTestFailed: Claude CLI test failed — check backend / CLI install

system.clientDataText: In Client mode the data folder is managed by the server. Edit dataFolder in the server's %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atlas\config.json to change it.

backup.title: Settings backup
backup.locationHint: App settings (appearance, brand, icons, AI toggle, etc.) are stored in the browser localStorage key pm-hub-settings.
backup.storageNote: In the desktop app this value lives in a binary LevelDB inside %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atlas\WebView2\, so it isn't visible as a file in Explorer. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atlas\config.json holds only connection/data-folder settings; the actual DB and attachments are in the data folder (e.g. Documents\ProjectManager\). Use Export below to back up or migrate settings to a file.
backup.importFailed: Import failed — check that it's a valid atlas-settings.json.
backup.resetHint: Theme, custom colors, brand, icons, last selected project, etc. return to defaults. (Does not affect DB data.)

reset.title: Reset settings
reset.message: Returns all settings to their initial state. Theme, custom colors, brand, icons, author name, last project, etc. will be lost.

icons.title: Icons
icons.menuHint: Sidebar navigation icons. Click to replace.
icons.entityHint: Item-type icons in the activity feed and search results.
